answer: Each node locks 64 GB dedicated RAM within memory orchard, filling pages via sequential Blake3 state iterations. Verifier then queries random page offsets at cycle nadir to confirm physical bus residency. Node commits resulting Blake3 digest plume into epoch-locked state root within 15 milliseconds. On verification mismatch or delayed return, verifier slashes 2500 staked tokens and purges peer identity. Operating 1000 fake nodes mandates 64 TB dedicated RAM costing $21000 monthly, rendering clone farms economically unviable.
